detail.longDescription: Stretched Kubernetes clusters look attractive: one API and one control plane across data centers. But quorum, latency, failure domains, and application requirements do not disappear. Since most organizations need multiple clusters anyway, it is often better to keep clusters simple and put the complexity in the multi-cluster layer. https://fale.io/blog/2026/11/02/on-stretched-kubernetes-clusters # Kubernetes # OpenShift # HighAvailability # MultiCluster
